blurb: Guests jump on trampolines in various areas including a special Little Air area for kids under 46 inches. The park offers jump sessions, birthday party packages, and special events with safety rules and waivers required. Food and drink policies apply for parties, and special jump sessions like Toddler Time and Club Air are available.
extraNote: All sales for jump time and party packages are final, no refunds or exchanges unless required by law · Party deposit is non-refundable · Parties can be rescheduled for free up to two days before; $50 fee if within 48 hours · Merchandise returns accepted within 30 days with receipt, issued as store credit · At the park location 3121 S 4th Ave, Ste B, Yuma, AZ 85364
